verdict.rationale: Postman CLI is well-documented as a headless tool for running collections in CI/CD pipelines, with combined use of the Postman API for programmatic asset management and integration into toolchains (postman-docs-1, postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19). Independent probe confirms the CLI's existence and official docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of CI usage (community evidence here focuses on desktop app complaints, not CLI/CI workflows).
